verdict.rationale: Forter is a fraud-prevention SaaS that processes customer and order data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion API or erasure workflow. Card tokenization to reduce PCI scope is a related security feature, not control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
